about: Kinds of desktop question agents answer by hand with hyprctl and screenshots, put to things that Omarchy's own defaults fix: what a keybinding does, which version is installed, which rule Omarchy sets for an app, which command does a job. Typical wording of the kinds: where a binding is used, why moving a window to another workspace no longer works, whether a binding can be added, and screenshot-driven checks of what an app shows. What is open and which monitors exist change from minute to minute, so those questions and the two script runs check the shape of the answer only. Expectations were checked against Hyprland 0.56 and Omarchy 4.5 with their default config; a config that overrides the defaults can differ. No window titles are kept here. Not yet run on a model.

questions.q: Which keybinding closes the focused window, and what does SUPER + SHIFT + RETURN open?
Which Omarchy version and which Hyprland version is this machine running?
Which window rule does Omarchy set for 1Password windows, and in which file?
Which layer rule does Omarchy set for its bar, and what does it do?
Which omarchy command turns the night light on and off?
How many windows are open right now, and on which workspaces?
Which monitors are connected, with resolution and scale?
Read me the text my terminal window is showing.
